responsibility: Render the live-data Ask Echo, Today Echo, recent imports, real collections and active background-task status using the approved balanced-canvas direction

inputs.visibleMemoryCount: Count of policy-allowed, non-excluded memories whose original source, stable memoryId, Focus route and display content can still be resolved
inputs.todayEcho: Optional real date/anniversary match from AwakeningCardRepositoryActor
inputs.recentImports: Stable ordered live memory card values
inputs.collections: Real metadata-derived topic or time collections; absent when unsupported
inputs.runtimeStatus: Live progress, offline and degradation state
inputs.scanProgress: Optional real active ProgressActor scan task; nil when no scan is active, completed or source authorization is missing
inputs.suggestions: Localized executable SearchPipeline query/filter payloads gated by current production capabilities; never result fixtures

outputs.visibleContent: Ask Echo followed by available Today Echo, recent imports, collections and active task status
outputs.accessibilityTree: Stable semantic section/card order independent of masonry packing

systemContainer: TabView + NavigationStack + ScrollView with system navigation and search behavior
fallbackConditions: Section has fewer than 6 real displayable cards
Available content width is below the exact 340pt masonry minimum
Long text or critical media requires continuous reading or safe fit
displayableDefinition: Policy allowed, non-excluded, source resolvable, stable memoryId and Focus route present, with real aspect ratio or real summary
emptyStateRule: Show determinate scan progress only for a real active ProgressActor task; otherwise show authorization/import guidance without ProgressView or scanning copy
gestureRule: Generic Discovery cards have no horizontal swipe; US-AWK-005 awakening cards are a dedicated variant with left-next/right-record-feeling plus equivalent visible and accessibility actions
